title: nixos/portmaster: replace activation script with preStart cleanup
reason: Applicable: real portmaster module + wired test (portmaster = runTest ./portmaster.nix; at head). Real diff moves cleanup logic from a separate system.activationScripts entry into the module's own systemd preStart, restructuring 3 lib.optionalString-guarded chunks (guarded by managesConfig/profilesEnabled, both local derivations of real options cfg.profiles etc.) into one concatenated preStart body -- a genuine predicate-adjacent restructuring, though the predicate itself is a derived local, not a direct mkIf on the watched option.
targets_toml: single target portmaster, cfg_ident=cfg, option_prefix=[services,portmaster], watch=[profiles] (profilesEnabled = cfg.profiles != {} is a direct derivation of this option; watched the option itself since the derived local isn't directly targetable).

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: Unchanged, plausibly correct: profiles itself has no DIRECT predicate (profilesEnabled, the derived local actually used in the restructured preStart, is what changed, not profiles' own predicate structure) -- oba's model watches declared options directly, not derived let-bindings, so this is an expected model-boundary miss rather than a gap, similar in spirit to earlier 'PredicateNotFound correctly' cases this round.
